name: oEmbed Configuration
description: adds basic configuration for oEmbed media resources.
project_description:
oEmbed configuration provides an UI to configure parameters that can enhance the display of oEmbed resouces.

 Back to top 

 Recommended modules 
 Although not required, some modules can be useful combined with oEmbed Configuration:

 
 oEmbed providers . 
 Key for a more secure experience. 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install the oEmbed Configurationmodule as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 The settings page is at Administration >> Configuration >> Media >> oEmbed Configuration.

 Back to top 

 Supported providers 
 So far, this module supports:

 
 YouTube (autoplay) 
 Vimeo (autoplay, do not track, background, etc) 
 X/Twitter (hide threads, do not track, theme, etc) 
 Instagram (omit script, authentication) 
 
 For all providers, an override configuration is available for the base path of the request, so things like replacing youtube.com with youtube-nocookie.com are possible with this module.

 Please suggest more integration and parameters through the issue queue:

 https://www.drupal.org/project/issues/oembed_configuration .
